Forward-Deployed Engineering

Inside your systems.
Accountable through to production.

Forward deployed engineers embed directly inside customer teams, work on live systems and unvarnished data, and turn high-stakes technical initiatives into software that runs reliably in production. No slide-only recommendations; no ticket handoffs.

Core Principles

The forward deployed engineering model

Why placing senior engineers directly inside customer teams delivers results faster and safer than traditional consulting or staff augmentation.

01 · Direct Presence

Embedded with your team

Joins your stand-ups, chat channels, and pairs with the operators who do the work. Uncovers the unstated workarounds, data quirks, and compliance hurdles that requirements documents miss.

02 · Live Systems

Hands-on in live environments

Designs and writes the code against your real systems and security rules. Prototypes bespoke API adapters, database synchronizers, and infrastructure code in days, not quarters.

03 · Production Ownership

Accountable to production

Measured by what actually ships and stays healthy under real production load. Stays until your internal team owns and extends the platform with complete operational autonomy.

Delivery Model

How forward deployed engineering differs

Combining the architectural judgment of a principal consultant, hands-on software engineering, and direct accountability for production outcomes.

Dimension Advisory Consulting Staff Augmentation Forward Deployed Engineering
Who does the work Advisors produce recommendations Contractors work assigned tickets Senior engineers who embed with your users and build
What you receive Reports and target-state designs Extra backlog capacity Working software in production, code, runbooks & ADRs
Who owns delivery Your team, after handover Your team, directing contractors End-to-end accountability until your team runs it
Time to first result Typically months Depends on backlog direction Working software in users' hands within weeks
What stays behind Documents Little once contractors leave Production code, decision records, and a self-sufficient team

Operational Lifecycle

Four phases from discovery to production

A structured, repeatable engineering methodology that moves from ambiguous requirements to self-sufficient client handover.

Phase 01 · Weeks 1–4

Discover & Prototype

Shadow operators, map unstated dependencies, uncover security & regulatory gates (HIPAA, FINRA, SOC 2), and build a thin working prototype against real data.

Phase 02 · Weeks 5–8

Build in Live Systems

Author bespoke microservices, event streams, or database CDC synchronization harnesses in Python/Node; demo working software against real data weekly.

Phase 03 · Weeks 9–12

Enterprise Hardening

Implement 4-tier decoupled Terraform 1.10+, keyless OIDC authentication, Karpenter dynamic autoscaling, automated SAST gates, and sub-minute disaster recovery.

Phase 04 · Weeks 13–16

Handover & Enablement

Abstract client adaptations into reusable platform modules, conduct client handover pairing, and leave behind complete operational runbooks and ADRs.
